display.summary: Two fixes from the 1.16.0b4 stress run. Public form limits keep each counter a few seconds past its window, so a flood no longer gets extra posts through at window boundaries. Caddy in new projects reads DLUX_FRONT_PROXY from .secrets/.env to choose which front proxies may forward client addresses; unset keeps trusting every private address, as before. Existing stacks get the same change from Composer 1.10.1's ./start.sh check --fix, and ./start.sh check warns while it is unset. Updates inline from any 1.16 release; no migrations.
highlights: Public form limits: each counter outlives its window by 5 seconds, so a flood no longer gets extra posts through at window boundaries.
DLUX_FRONT_PROXY in .secrets/.env names the front proxies Caddy trusts for client addresses; unset keeps trusting every private address.
No front proxy? Set DLUX_FRONT_PROXY= (empty) so users on your network cannot choose the address used for login lockout and the audit log.
Existing stacks: Composer 1.10.1's ./start.sh check warns while it is unset, and check --fix moves the Caddyfile and compose to the variable.
Or firewall the server so only the front proxy reaches Caddy's port. Updates inline from any 1.16 release, with no migrations.
